title: Joint Petition of 5-K Transport, Inc. and RoNo Transportation Corporation for approval by the Department, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7A of the transfer of Charter License No. 17092 from 5-K Transport, Inc. to RoNo Transportation Corporation and for approval of certain amendments, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 11A, including a change of address, place of business and place of garaging from Acton to Stow and by permitting trips originating in Maynard, Sudbury, Stowe, Westford and Hudson.
